description: CONFORMANCE.md §9.3.1 clock-skew tolerance. Future-dated fields and expires_at fields have separate tiered rules; this vector enumerates the boundaries (0, 5, 15 minutes) so implementations can verify they fall in the right tier at the right boundary value.

vectors.description: Future-dated timestamp samples. T - now ranges from 0 to 30 minutes. Per §9.3.1: MUST accept at 0-5 min; SHOULD reject at >5 min; MUST reject at >15 min.

samples.reason: boundary: SHOULD reject at >5 min, MUST accept at <=5 min
between SHOULD-reject (5 min) and MUST-reject (15 min)
boundary: MUST reject when T - now > 15 min; at equality either verdict is conformant
15 min + 1 sec ahead: strictly greater than 15 min, MUST reject

vectors.description: expires_at samples. now - T ranges from -60 sec to 15+ min. Per §9.3.1: implementations SHOULD reject at now > T; MAY apply up to 5 min grace; MUST reject at now > T + 15 min.

samples.reason: now == expires_at; SHOULD reject but MAY apply 0-5 min grace
1 min past expires; MAY apply up to 5 min grace
5 min past; boundary of grace window
10 min past; outside grace but inside MUST-reject window
